children: Tesla (TSLA) is pursuing Terafab, a dedicated chip-factory project. Company guides over $25 billion in annual spending and may allocate additional capital to build and ramp the chip plant.
Barclays noted speculation SpaceX may acquire Tesla (TSLA) in an all-stock deal within 6–12 months or before Tesla’s 2026 meeting, with Musk keeping majority voting control via dual-class shares.
Tesla (TSLA) reports earnings Oct. 21. Traders watch management commentary on Terafab progress, capital plan, and effects of FSD, Robotaxi and Optimus on margins and strategy metrics.
A proposed merger for Tesla (TSLA) would need antitrust review and dual shareholder approval; Barclays noted potential vertical integration gains in AI, robotics, and SpaceX-related data and chips.
TSLA fell ~2% overnight before the Roadster event and ~4% for the week; trading volume was below average as investors awaited the Roadster amid inflation and rate-hike concerns.
Tesla (TSLA) again delayed its Roadster live demo due to outdoor weather. The event is rescheduled for Thursday at 7:55 p.m. Central after prior October postponements and a two-week delay.
On Oct 6 Tesla (TSLA) batteries discharged a record 745 MW to California’s grid during an evening heat-wave peak, boosting supply amid high demand.
For full-year 2025 global vehicle sales, BYD outsold Tesla (TSLA) in total units worldwide, reporting higher unit sales for the 2025 calendar year versus Tesla.
